cases.description: When getEvaluationParentSchema() returns null the method should skip the while‑loop and return false because no adjacent validator can be found.
A non‑null parent schema exists but its getValidators() collection is empty. The loop iterates once, finds no matching validator, moves to the next parent (null) and finally returns false.

group: Direct match in first parent schema

cases.description: The immediate evaluation parent schema contains a validator whose getKeyword() equals the supplied keyword. The method should set hasValidator to true, break out of the for‑loop and the while‑loop and return true.

The first (closest) parent schema does not contain a matching validator, but its own evaluation parent (grand‑parent) does. The method must continue the while‑loop, locate the match in the ancestor and return true.

The parent schema holds several validators; the matching one appears before others. The method should stop iterating the validator list as soon as the match is found (break), and not evaluate remaining validators.
A validator in the parent schema returns null from getKeyword(). The equals check (keyword.equals(null)) returns false, so the method must continue searching and finally return false.
Passing a null keyword leads to a NullPointerException when the code executes keyword.equals(...). The test verifies that the method does not swallow the exception.
Three ancestor schemas each contain several validators, but none of them have the keyword "minimum". The method must walk the whole chain and finally return false.

group: Keyword matches validator in current schema only

cases.description: The validator's own schema (the one being evaluated) holds a validator with keyword "type" while all evaluation‑parent schemas lack it. Since the method only inspects parent schemas, it should return false.
One of the entries returned by getValidators() on the evaluation‑parent schema is null. When the loop reaches this entry, calling validator.getKeyword() triggers a NullPointerException.
The evaluation‑parent schema's getValidators() method returns null. The enhanced‑for loop attempts to iterate over a null collection, causing a NullPointerException.

group: Empty keyword matches empty validator keyword

cases.description: A validator in the nearest evaluation‑parent schema returns an empty string from getKeyword(). The equals check succeeds, so the method returns true.
A validator exists with keyword "maxLength" (lower‑case "m"). Because String.equals is case‑sensitive, the supplied upper‑case keyword does not match and the method returns false.

group: Keyword with surrounding whitespace does not match

cases.description: The parent schema contains a validator whose keyword is "pattern" (no spaces). The supplied keyword includes leading and trailing spaces, so equals fails and the method returns false.

The evaluation‑parent schema's getValidators() returns a collection that includes an object which does not implement JsonValidator. During the enhanced for‑loop the JVM attempts to cast the element to JsonValidator, resulting in a ClassCastException.
